feeling: I can't switch my brain off.
name: Anxiety & overthinking
body: Worry loops, 3am what-ifs, the body braced for something that never arrives. We slow the spiral down and build a few tools that actually hold up on a bad day.

feeling: I'm functioning, but I don't feel like myself.
name: Low mood & burnout
body: Getting through the days on autopilot, joy on mute. We look at what's draining you, what's been lost along the way, and what small things bring colour back.

feeling: We keep having the same fight.
name: Couples & relationships
body: For partners who love each other and keep ending up in the same argument. We find the pattern underneath it and practise a different way through.

name: Life transitions
body: A move, a breakup, a new baby, a diagnosis, a parent getting older. Space to steady yourself while the ground shifts, and to decide who you want to be on the other side.

feeling: I'm still carrying something from a long time ago.
name: Grief & past hurt
body: Loss that doesn't fit the timeline people expect, and older wounds that keep resurfacing. We go gently, at a pace that feels safe, and never faster.

feeling: Things are better — I want to keep it that way.
name: Check-ins & maintenance
body: Monthly sessions for people who've done the work and want somewhere to keep thinking out loud before small clouds become weather.
